description:
psycopg2-binary has been in maintenance-only mode since 2022. psycopg3 (PyPI package:
`psycopg`) is the designated successor from the same author (Daniele Varrazzo), built on
the same libpq foundation with active development, better wheel coverage (consistent
macOS ARM64 support), and native async support. psycopg2-binary bundles its own OpenSSL,
triggering security-scanner false positives; psycopg3[binary] has the same bundling model
but a cleaner, maintained build.

BenchBox uses psycopg2 across one shared mixin, five platform adapters, two dev scripts,
and four test files:

  Platform adapters:
    benchbox/platforms/base/psycopg2_mixin.py  - shared connection/cursor mechanics
    benchbox/platforms/postgresql.py            - most complex: copy_expert() bulk load
    benchbox/platforms/timescaledb.py           - psycopg2.sql for safe DDL composition
    benchbox/platforms/questdb.py               - inherits mixin; psycopg2.extras vestigial
    benchbox/platforms/pg_mooncake.py           - psycopg2.sql for GUC/DDL composition
    benchbox/platforms/pg_duckdb.py             - psycopg2.sql for GUC composition
    benchbox/platforms/redshift.py              - psycopg2 as fallback when redshift-connector absent

  pyproject.toml dependency declarations (4 sites):
    line 112: "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.0"  (extras:all)
    line 170: postgresql = ["psycopg2-binary>=2.9.0"]
    line 171: questdb = ["psycopg2-binary>=2.9.0", "requests>=2.28.0"]
    line 464: "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.0"  (dev group)

  Scripts: scripts/probe_mooncake_types.py, scripts/benchmark_mooncake_migration.py

  Tests:
    tests/unit/platforms/test_postgresql_adapter.py
    tests/unit/platforms/test_psycopg2_mixin.py
    tests/unit/core/test_platform_registry.py
    tests/integration/platforms/common.py

The only non-trivial code change is postgresql.py's two `cursor.copy_expert()` calls
(lines 500 and 505), which must be rewritten to use psycopg3's `cursor.copy()` context
manager. The psycopg.sql module (sql.SQL, sql.Identifier, sql.Literal) has an IDENTICAL
API to psycopg2.sql - no usage sites change beyond the import path.

This item was deferred from the `tighten-dependencies-phase-plan` audit as
"driver modernization - out of scope for an elimination audit. File separately when
product is ready."

Change 3 - COPY bulk load rewrite (lines 500 and 505):
  cursor.copy_expert() does not exist in psycopg3. Replace with cursor.copy() context
  manager. Both source paths open in text mode (mode="rt" or encoding="utf-8") so
  chunk is str; psycopg3 copy.write() accepts str for text-format COPY.
  Use 64KB chunk reads - NOT f.read() whole-file - to preserve memory profile for
  large TPC-H data files (lineitem at SF>=1 can exceed available RAM).

  Before (line 500, io.StringIO path):
    cursor.copy_expert(
        f"COPY {qualified_table} FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT csv, DELIMITER '{delimiter}')",
        data_buffer,
    )
  After:
    with cursor.copy(
        f"COPY {qualified_table} FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT csv, DELIMITER '{delimiter}')"
    ) as copy:
        while chunk := data_buffer.read(65536):
            copy.write(chunk)

  Before (line 505, file object path):
    cursor.copy_expert(
        f"COPY {qualified_table} FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT csv, DELIMITER '{delimiter}')",
        f,
    )
  After:
    with cursor.copy(
        f"COPY {qualified_table} FROM STDIN WITH (FORMAT csv, DELIMITER '{delimiter}')"
    ) as copy:
        while chunk := f.read(65536):
            copy.write(chunk)
